**Where the data would come from, if you know**

This project only shows what the game's own files or the save actually state
(`docs/GAMEDATA-SOURCES.md` maps what exists). "The wiki says X" is a lead,
not a source — features built on wiki figures get declined, features built on
a named DataTable or save field get built.
